settings.title: The full ingredient list
settings.content: Grass-fed beef tallow, raw wildflower honey, golden beeswax, cold-pressed extra-virgin olive oil. That's the entire list — no water, fragrance, preservatives or seed oils.

settings.content: Warm a pea-sized amount and press into damp skin — face, lips, hands, elbows, scars. Morning and night.
